summary: Published the staged public and staff trees on node1 TCP port 8080 with persistent HTTP Basic authentication. The configuration survived a verified node reboot; the OS release, kernel, and staged files remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Created a dedicated unprivileged web service using the installed Python runtime.
Exposed /public/ anonymously and protected all /staff/ content for the reader account.
Stored only a salted password verifier; kept access.txt root-only and outside served routes.
Disabled directory listing through explicit file routing and blocked traversal attempts.
Enabled the service at boot and completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol for node1.

evidence.requirement: Public pages are anonymously available on TCP 8080
evidence.summary: Shows the 0.0.0.0:8080 listener and exact HTTP 200 public-page delivery before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Staff pages require HTTP Basic authentication as reader; failed authentication exposes no staff content
evidence.summary: No credentials, wrong password, and wrong username return 401 with a Basic challenge and no protected content; valid reader authentication returns exact staff files.

evidence.requirement: Neither credential files nor directory listings are served
evidence.summary: access.txt remains root-owned mode 0600; direct and traversal requests return 404, as does a directory-listing probe.

evidence.requirement: Supplied pages remain intact and the installed OS release/kernel are retained
evidence.summary: Pre/post file hashes match. CentOS Stream 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 remain installed after the work and reboot.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Captured healthy baseline boot ID d052eb57-c81d-4309-ae7f-bce362073ff9, acknowledged the scheduled native reboot, observed new boot ID f1deef68-9dda-4c51-a5f6-bd739fcdff55, then proved enabled/active service, listener, unchanged data, and recovered access controls.
